intro: A kitchen renovation is the single most impactful home improvement a Salisbury homeowner can undertake, and it is a project that requires careful sequencing, reliable trades, and a single point of contact to prevent the inevitable complications from becoming delays. Kitchen renovation is part of our renovation services in Salisbury, with painting and decorating completing the final finish. FixWell Services manages kitchen renovations across Salisbury and Wiltshire, from a cosmetic refresh of doors and worktops to a full strip-out and new kitchen installation. sections.heading: The Spectrum of Kitchen Renovation Work
sections.body: Kitchen renovation covers a very wide range of scope and investment, and understanding where your project sits is the first step to planning it effectively. A cosmetic kitchen refresh, replacing door and drawer fronts, fitting new handles, installing a new worktop, and repainting the walls, can transform a tired kitchen for a fraction of the cost of new units and is typically completed in two to four days. A mid-range refurbishment swaps the carcasses and doors for new units while retaining the existing layout and plumbing positions, typically taking five to eight days. A full renovation strips the kitchen back to bare walls and floor, replanning the layout and relocating supply and waste runs, replacing everything from the wall tiles to the ceiling finish; this is a one to two-week project requiring coordination with Gas Safe and electrical contractors for any moved services. FixWell Services manages all three levels of scope, coordinating specialist trades where required.

sections.heading: Kitchen Component Materials and Style Choices
sections.body: The cabinet carcass is almost universally 18mm E1-grade moisture-resistant (MR) MDF or particleboard in modern fitted kitchens; the variation is in the door and drawer front style and material. Shaker-style painted MDF doors (the most popular choice in Salisbury's period properties, where they complement the architectural character) can be supplied in any RAL or Farrow & Ball colour and repainted in future. Vinyl-wrapped or foil-wrapped doors offer durability in high-moisture environments. Solid timber doors (oak, walnut) provide a premium natural finish. Worktop choice has a significant effect on both aesthetics and budget: post-formed laminate (28mm or 40mm) is the most cost-effective and widely available option; solid oak oiled worktop adds warmth and natural character; engineered quartz (Silestone, Caesarstone) provides durability and a seamless appearance; Dekton (ultra-compact surface) is at the premium end. Splashback options include ceramic tile (most common, easiest to retile in future), glass panel (easy-clean, modern aesthetic), and stainless steel (commercial appearance, popular in Salisbury rental properties for low maintenance).

sections.heading: How FixWell Manages a Kitchen Renovation
sections.body: Our kitchen renovation process begins with a detailed site survey: measuring the room precisely, noting window and door positions, identifying current plumbing and electrical connection points, and confirming the wall construction (critical for ensuring units can be fixed securely). We produce a drawing of the proposed layout and agree the scope before any work begins. On the project start date, we carry out a controlled demolition of the existing kitchen, removing units carefully to avoid damaging plasterwork, disconnecting supply flexibles and waste connections, and cutting out any screed or tile that needs replacing. Wall preparation follows: filling, rendering flat any damaged sections, and priming before unit installation. New unit carcasses are installed from a level datum line, scribed to any out-of-square walls, and secured to solid fixings. Worktops are template-cut to achieve clean mitre joins and perfect scribe fits to the wall. Door hanging and handle fitting is the final carpentry stage before the tiler and electrician complete their elements.

sections.heading: Cost, Timeframe, and Salisbury Housing Context
sections.body: Salisbury's housing stock presents specific kitchen renovation challenges that affect both cost and programme. Victorian terraced properties throughout the city have narrow galley kitchen layouts, often 1.8–2.2m wide, that limit standard 600mm base unit runs and require careful planning of corner solutions and appliance placement. Solid brick and stone internal walls require SDS drilling for every unit fixing, which takes longer than fixing to a modern stud partition but provides very secure anchorage. Many 1960s–80s Salisbury semis have internal kitchen walls built in thermalite block, which requires the correct masonry drill bit and fixing specification to hold unit loads safely. Labour cost at our standard rate of £20–£40/hr; a kitchen refresh (new doors, worktop, paint) runs to approximately four to six days of skilled labour. A full renovation is priced on a fixed-price basis following the site survey. Kitchen units and materials are sourced by the customer or supplied and managed by FixWell; either approach is accommodated.

sections.heading: Kitchen Renovation and the Wider Renovation Service
sections.body: Kitchen renovation is the most complex project within FixWell's renovation services in Salisbury, requiring coordination between carpentry, plumbing, tiling, and electrical trades. For any kitchen where the gas hob connection is being altered or the gas supply relocated, a Gas Safe registered engineer must be used for that element; FixWell works with trusted Gas Safe contractors in Salisbury and manages the coordination. New electrical circuits in a kitchen, or any extension of the ring main, require a Part P registered electrician and formal notification; FixWell coordinates this as part of the project. For homeowners planning a kitchen renovation in Salisbury and wanting to understand the scope, sequence, and budget before committing, we offer a no-obligation site visit and written assessment. Call +44 7391 599 078 to arrange, or use the quote form on this page.

faqs.q: How long does a kitchen renovation take in Salisbury?
faqs.a: A cosmetic refresh (new doors, worktops, paint) typically takes 3–5 days. A full cabinet replacement retaining the same layout takes 5–8 days. A full strip-out and replanned renovation may take 10–15 days depending on scope and trade coordination required.

faqs.q: Can you project-manage the whole kitchen renovation or do I need separate trades?
faqs.a: FixWell manages the full kitchen renovation as a single engagement, coordinating any Gas Safe or electrical sub-contractors required. You have one point of contact throughout, and the project programme is agreed at the outset.

faqs.q: Do I need to buy my own kitchen units or can you supply them?
faqs.a: Either approach works. Many customers specify and purchase their own units from IKEA, Howdens, B&Q, or a trade supplier and we fit them. Alternatively, we can advise on suppliers and manage the order for you. Both are accommodated in our quotation.

faqs.q: Can you fit a kitchen in a Victorian terraced house in Salisbury?
faqs.a: Yes. Victorian terraced kitchens typically have narrow galley layouts and solid brick or stone walls. We have significant experience working in these constraints and will survey the space carefully before designing the unit layout to make the best use of the available width and fixing points.

faqs.q: Will you need to move the plumbing or electrics for my new kitchen?
faqs.a: For a like-for-like replacement (same layout, same appliance positions) plumbing and electrical moves are rarely needed. For a replanned layout, supply and waste relocation may be required. Gas connections and new electrical circuits must be carried out by registered contractors. We coordinate these as part of the project.

faqs.q: How much does a kitchen renovation cost in Salisbury?
faqs.a: Labour at £20–£40/hr; a cosmetic refresh totals approximately 4–6 days labour. Full renovation labour costs depend on scope and are quoted on a fixed-price basis after a site survey. Kitchen unit and materials costs are in addition and vary widely by specification.
